staticSite.spaceKindNotice: Raw-capture and generated-knowledge spaces are never published, whatever their visibility. Promote that material into an ordinary wiki page to publish it.
staticSite.reuseKey: Reuse the Git export deploy key
staticSite.reuseKeyHint: Git export already has a deploy key on this repository. A key can only be registered on one repository, so reusing it here saves installing a second one.
staticSite.reuseKeyDifferentRepo: Git export uses a different repository, so its deploy key cannot be reused — a key can only be registered on one repository. Generate a key for this one.
staticSite.reuseKeyDone: Deploy key reused. No further setup is needed on the repository.
staticSite.credentialFromIntegration: Authentication comes from the shared GitHub integration, so it is configured once for every feature that reaches GitHub:
staticSite.baseUrlMismatch: This does not match how GitHub Pages serves {repo}. Unless you have set up a custom domain, the address should be {expected} — a mismatch makes every link, image, and stylesheet on the published site resolve against the wrong root.
staticSite.baseUrlCustomDomain: Treated as a custom domain. A CNAME file is published so GitHub Pages keeps serving it; the domain must also point at GitHub Pages in DNS, and GitHub Pages must have it configured.

integrations.keyGenerated: Deploy key generated. Install it on the repository.
